articles.title: New Jersey mother, son sue zoning board over rejected bayfront home plan
articles.description: A New Jersey mother and her son have approached the court after a township zoning board rejected their plan to build a three-storey house on their bayfront plot. They argue that the board failed to properly consider expert evidence and the property's existing limitations. The family wants the rejection overturned and has also sought compensation, claiming that the decision effectively deprives them of the use of their land.

articles.title: Colleen Begg is the first woman to win Prince William’s Tusk lifetime award
articles.description: Dr. Colleen Begg has earned the prestigious 2026 Prince William Award due to her remarkable contributions to wildlife conservation in Mozambique. Initially researching honey badgers, she then redirected her passion towards safeguarding lions and other carnivores. Together with her husband, they launched the Niassa Carnivore Project, promoting local community involvement and empowering women in Africa's environmental leadership.

articles.author: MAYUR SHETTY
articles.title: In a first, credit card spends pip ATM withdrawals
articles.description: In a significant milestone for India’s financial landscape, October 2026 marked the first month where credit card spending overtook ATM withdrawals. With credit card transactions soaring to over Rs 2.4 lakh crore compared to Rs 2.3 lakh crore in ATM withdrawals, this evolution underscores changing consumer preferences. Remarkably, credit card spending saw a year-on-year increase of 14.4 percent, highlighting a shift that began back in November 2019.
